## Problem statement

What gap or pain point does this solve? Keep it specific. "Users can't easily do X" is more useful than "there should be better UX".

## Proposed solution

Describe the feature or behavior you'd like. If it touches the API layer, note which `client/src/lib/api.ts` function or endpoint shape is involved.

## Examples or references

Screenshots, mockups, or links to the [LockA documentation](https://github.com/LockA-Medical-Passport/LockA-Documentation) / [EVM reference app](https://locka.remixdapp.eth.limo/) that illustrate the idea.

## Alternatives considered

Any approaches you considered and why you didn't pick them (optional).

## Current workaround

How are you working around this today, if at all?
